status: completed exploratory nested task-held-out development evaluation

dataset.label_scope: same task retrieval proxy, not actor or organization identity
dataset.reuse_boundary: The same task groups were inspected by earlier experiments; results are exploratory, not independent confirmation.

selection_rule: select only an inner-OOF policy with strictly lower overall FMR, no higher overall or subgroup FSR, and no worse other estimable subgroup error, balanced accuracy, query coverage, or rank metric; among feasible hard-negative verifier thresholds choose the highest cutoff; if none passes, retain the command baseline

new_methods.human_command_extraction: Recover executed Human shell commands from the terminal output transcript, interpreting backspace, cursor movement, and insert/delete controls; task-score answers, targets, and task labels are not used as features.
new_methods.idf_lcs_coverage: IDF-weighted command sequence alignment coverage plus weighted command and bigram overlap, with mild length-mismatch penalty
new_methods.phase_gated_lcs: geometric mean of IDF-LCS coverage and four-phase action-profile similarity
new_methods.mutual_rank_fusion: query-relative reciprocal-rank fusion over command, 24D profile, 4x8x3 tensor, and local-sequence scores; symmetrized by geometric mean of both directional fused ranks
new_methods.operand_jaccard: training-IDF Jaccard of normalized command flags, file extensions, artifact-name tokens, and URL host/path tokens
new_methods.operand_aware_command: 0.45 command TF-IDF plus 0.55 training-IDF operand signature similarity
new_methods.artifact_containment_command: 0.45 command TF-IDF plus 0.55 training-IDF-weighted containment of distinctive artifact-name tokens in the shorter trace signature; generic tool/path words are excluded
new_methods.artifact_containment: training-only IDF containment of distinctive artifact-name tokens in the shorter trace signature; unknown test artifacts use the training maximum weight
new_methods.reciprocal_consensus: query-local reciprocal rank consensus over three evidence families: command/artifact content, command order, and behavioral profile/tensor/phase
new_methods.neighborhood_verified: reciprocal consensus modulated by the Jaccard overlap of each trace's top-3 candidate neighborhoods; shared neighbors can confirm but cannot independently create a link
new_methods.verifier_candidate_sweep: Each verifier is evaluated with the same nested split at candidate unions of top-12, top-16, and top-20 per content, sequence, and behavior family. The verifier is trained once on the maximum candidate pool within each training fold; thresholds and candidate width are selected only from inner out-of-fold predictions.
new_methods.verifier_generic: regularized pair verifier trained with same-task positives, top-ranked wrong-task hard negatives, and a small random negative sample
new_methods.verifier_mode_conditioned: same hard-negative verifier with task-crossfit predicted Human/Agent probabilities interacting with each trace side's profile, tensor, and phase evidence
new_methods.verifier_no_human_profile: mode-conditioned verifier ablation removing Human-query and Human-candidate profile interactions
new_methods.verifier_no_agent_profile: mode-conditioned verifier ablation removing Agent-query and Agent-candidate profile interactions
new_methods.verifier_no_phase_tensor: mode-conditioned verifier ablation without action-phase and tensor evidence
new_methods.verifier_no_neighborhood: mode-conditioned verifier ablation without reciprocal-neighborhood evidence

candidate_generation.rule: union of the top-k candidates from content, sequence, and behavior evidence families, separately within benchmark; k is selected from 12/16/20 by inner task-grouped validation only
